_comment: 2011 base-year controls and calibration targets (PLAN §11.4). 'source' says where each number comes from; 'estimate: true' marks numbers still to verify against a primary source. OTC is a game: estimates are fine, as long as they are labelled.

ottawa.source: Estimate: Ottawa–Gatineau CMA employment (~0.56 jobs per resident) split by where the floor space is; to verify against the 2011 census place-of-work tables or the City of Ottawa employment survey.

post_secondary.source: Estimate: uOttawa, Carleton, Algonquin, La Cité, UQO and the Cégep de l'Outaouais, full- and part-time, 2010–11.

school_share_of_population.source: Estimate: ages 5–17 are about 15% of the population.

workers_share.source: Estimate: employed residents per resident in the Ottawa–Gatineau CMA.

transit_share_all_trips.source: PLAN §11.4: 2011 TRANS NCR Origin-Destination Survey, regional transit share of all trips (to verify against the published survey report).

walk_share_all_trips.source: Estimate, to verify against the 2011 OD survey.

bike_share_all_trips.source: Estimate (annual average), to verify against the 2011 OD survey.

octranspo_weekday_boardings.source: APTA Transit Ridership Report, Q1 2010, average weekday unlinked trips, via Wikipedia 'OC Transpo' rev 509566374 (28 Aug 2012) https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=509566374

sto_weekday_boardings.source: Estimate: 16.3 million passengers in 2006, planned 21 million by 2015 (Wikipedia 'Société de transport de l'Outaouais' (fr) rev 80436278, 3 Jul 2012, https://fr.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=80436278), so about 18.5 million in 2011, at ~250 weekday-equivalents a year.

passenger_share_all_trips.source: Estimate (car passengers, including children driven to school), to verify against the 2011 OD survey.

trips_per_resident.source: Estimate: weekday trips per resident, all modes. Set at 2.5 (a typical North American level) so that OC Transpo's sourced weekday boardings land within tolerance; to verify against the 2011 OD survey.
